summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, stdlib os/json only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data list key raises ValueError; a non-dict top-level JSON value is reported as a missing key; the file check uses os.path.isfile; base_dir defaults to the datalist's dirname. Nothing was committed. Tests and black/flake8 were NOT run, per instructions; line lengths were checked by measurement (none over 120) and formatting by reading only.
